title: Maz Kanata
description: More than a thousand years old, Maz Kanata had been running a watering hole out of her castle on Takodana for centuries. She watched empires rise and fall and could feel the ebbs and flows of the Force itself. She had acquired the Lightsaber of Anakin Skywalker that had been passed down to Luke Skywalker and was destined for Rey Skywalker under mysterious circumstances.
